description.value: Households in Ocala that shop primarily on initial price and perceived value (promo-driven), but will switch for reliable multi-gig fiber, transparent pricing and local support.

demographic_signals.value: Price-sensitive; responsive to time-limited promos and streaming credits.
Households with multiple streamers and remote workers who value reliability and unlimited data.

description.value: Local small businesses frustrated with incumbents' distant support or variable reliability, open to switching for faster local technician response and predictable billing.

demographic_signals.value: Values local field technicians and faster on-site SLAs over pure price.
Likely to be influenced by professional-install inclusions and uptime guarantees.

pain_statement.value: Promo-driven incumbent pricing leads to initial low monthly costs but causes confusion and post-promo bill shock.

desired_outcome.value: Clear, predictable pricing (transparent post-promo rates and blended examples) and simple, communicated renewal terms.

pain_statement.value: Mobile + internet bundles from incumbents change effective price and make simple Internet-only comparisons difficult.

desired_outcome.value: A value narrative that normalizes the lack of a mobile bundle (explicitly explaining comparative total cost of ownership) or offers alternative bundle equivalents.

pain_statement.value: Low local brand recognition for Wire3 reduces trust among switchers compared with national incumbents.

desired_outcome.value: Fast awareness and social proof (local PR, testimonials, visible construction milestones) to build trust and lower perceived risk of switching.

headline.value: Ocala’s local fiber alternative: predictable pricing, multi-gig reliability, and fast local support.

supporting_points.value: Multi-gig symmetric fiber plans with included eero Wi‑Fi and professional installation.
Promotions to lower early friction (first month free, streaming credits) timed with build milestones.
Local technicians and faster on-site response for residential and small-business customers.

no_bundle_gap_response.value: Explicitly acknowledge Wire3 does not offer a mobile bundle; position Internet + streaming + included Wi‑Fi devices as an alternative value stack and offer partner streaming credits/referral discounts to narrow the perceived gap.

low_brand_recognition_response.value: Accelerate visible local credibility via construction milestone PR, neighborhood install spotlights, local testimonials, and trial promotions tied to on-site pro installs.

positioning_statement.value: Wire3 is Ocala’s locally built fiber provider offering multi-gig symmetric speeds, transparent launch pricing, and rapid local support—an alternative to incumbent bundle-driven offers.

differentiators.value: Visible local fiber construction and availability claims backed by region-specific rollout messaging.
Included enhanced Wi‑Fi (eero) and professional installation to reduce friction at sign-up.
Local field technicians and small-business support emphasis for faster SLAs.

supporting_message.value: Advertise symmetric multi-gig fiber, no data caps, and included eero Wi‑Fi to show superior reliability for heavy users and remote work.
Lead with promo details and clearly communicate post-promo pricing examples to reduce bill-shock and build trust.
Promote local technicians, faster on-site response and business-focused SLAs to win customers frustrated with distant call centers.
Explain the comparative TCO: high-speed fiber + streaming credits + included Wi‑Fi can match or beat bundle-adjusted prices from incumbents.

rationale.value: Paid search and social ads capture active switchers searching promo terms and highlight time-limited offers tied to availability checks.

channels.channel_name: Local SEO, availability landing pages & organic social

rationale.value: Organic channels build credibility around local availability, construction milestones, and testimonials at low cost.

channels.channel_name: Local events, community PR and direct mail

rationale.value: Community activation (press about build milestones, booth at local events, direct mail) builds trust among residents who prefer local proof points.
Partnering for streaming credits or local business bundles replicates some perceived value of mobile bundles without building a mobile product.
Referral incentives and installer neighborhood outreach convert nearby homes during build phases and amplify local testimonials.

activities.value: Publish availability map, construction milestone PR and neighborhood-level landing pages with promo messaging.
Run targeted digital ads to price/value switchers promoting first-month-free and streaming credits.

launch_phases.exit_criteria: Availability pages live for target neighborhoods; initial digital campaigns achieving target CTR and landing-page conversion rates (see metrics).

activities.value: Offer clear promo pricing with explicit post-promo examples at checkout; enable pro-install scheduling and local tech introductions.
Activate referral incentives and streaming partner credits at install to offset lack of mobile bundle.

launch_phases.exit_criteria: Achieve target new-customer sign-ups in build areas and maintain installation quality KPIs below defect threshold.

activities.value: Push referral campaigns, monitor local NPS and quickly remediate installation complaints with local crews.
Iterate pricing packages and consider limited third-party mobile/ISP partnerships if needed to close bundle-sensitive segments.

launch_phases.exit_criteria: Sustained monthly net adds and retention above target thresholds; referral program drives a growing share of new sign-ups.

success_metrics.name: Net new subscribers in Ocala (first 6 months)
success_metrics.definition: Count of activated residential and small-business subscriptions in target Ocala neighborhoods within 6 months of campaign start.

target_value.value: 1,000 net new subscribers in 6 months (illustrative regional target)

success_metrics.name: Promo-to-paid conversion rate (month 1 -> month 3)
success_metrics.definition: Share of promo-originated customers who remain active after the immediate promo period (indicator of post-promo satisfaction).

success_metrics.name: Installation quality / defect rate
success_metrics.definition: Percentage of installs requiring rework or causing customer complaints within 30 days.

success_metrics.name: Local NPS (residential & small business)
success_metrics.definition: Net Promoter Score measured for Ocala customers to assess local credibility and support performance.

statement.value: Incumbents use aggressive mobile+internet bundles and promo stacking to defend customers, making switch economics harder for Wire3.

mitigation.value: Emphasize alternative value (streaming credits, included Wi‑Fi), transparent TCO comparisons, and local support benefits; explore partnerships to mimic bundle economics.

statement.value: Local reports of installation damage or service disruptions could slow adoption during rollout.

mitigation.value: Deploy quality-grade installation SOPs, rapid local remediation teams, and proactive communications; surface testimonials from clean installs promptly.

statement.value: Post-promo churn or perceived bill-shock if post-promo rates are unclear or high.

mitigation.value: Publish clear post-promo pricing examples at point-of-sale, offer blended 12-month pricing options and proactive renewal reminders to set expectations.

follow_up_research_questions.question: What are Wire3’s standard post-promo monthly prices by tier (all published non-promotional rates) and any long-term rate guarantees for Ocala addresses?
follow_up_research_questions.rationale: Analyst evidence documents promotional pricing but does not list definitive post-promo standard monthly rates across tiers (needed to craft transparent TCO messaging).

follow_up_research_questions.question: What are the exact early-termination fees (ETFs) and equipment rental fees for Spectrum, AT&T and T-Mobile in Marion County addresses to allow competitive price comparisons?
follow_up_research_questions.rationale: Competitive fee schedules are referenced but not compiled; exact numbers are needed to produce apples-to-apples comparisons for switcher messaging.

follow_up_research_questions.question: Can Wire3 provide a street-level serviceability map or address-level availability polygons for Marion County / Ocala to enable precise direct-marketing and door-hanger targeting?
follow_up_research_questions.rationale: Precise address-level availability is not present in the evidence; availability polygons are needed to focus local offline and paid campaigns and avoid wasted spend.
